map.支持方向观测法与复测法，计算角度均值、精度指标并检核盘左盘右差: Supports the direction method and repetition method, computes the angle mean and precision metrics, and checks the face-left/face-right difference
map.📖 查看「角度测量计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Angle Measurement Calculation User Guide"
map.盘左 / 盘右 读数（每行一组，格式：盘左,盘右，如 0.0200,180.02: Face-left / face-right readings (one pair per line, format: face-left,face-right, e.g. 0.0200,180.0210)
map.💡 盘左盘右均值消除视准轴误差；2C = 盘左 −（盘右±180°），各测回2C: 💡 Averaging face-left and face-right removes the collimation-axis error; 2C = face-left − (face-right ±180°), and the 2C spread across sets must stay within the limit
map.各次观测角度（每行一个，复测法可填累积读数或单次角度）: Each observed angle (one per line; for the repetition method enter cumulative readings or single angles)
map.💡 复测法通过多次累测降低读数误差；均值标准误差 SE = s/√n，n 为复测: 💡 The repetition method reduces reading error through repeated accumulation; standard error of the mean SE = s/√n, where n is the repetition count
map.测量格式 90.3025 表示 90°30'25\"（度.分秒，分秒各两位）: Surveying format 90.3025 means 90°30'25" (deg.minsec, two digits each for min and sec)
map.方向观测法按各测回方向值计算均值与2C互差；复测法按多次角度计算均值与精度: The direction method computes the mean and 2C spread from each set's direction values; the repetition method computes the mean and precision from multiple angles
map.结果用于教学与一般工程参考，精密控制测量需按规范平差: Results are for teaching and general engineering reference; precise control surveys must be adjusted per the specification
map.📚 深度解析：角度夹角与 2C 检核: 📚 In-depth: Angle Between Lines and 2C Check
map.两方向 L/R 取平均得方向值，相邻方向差即夹角，超限重测。: Average the L/R of two directions to get the direction value; the difference of adjacent directions is the included angle, remeasure if out of limit.
map.同一目标盘左盘右读数差（归算到同侧应 ±180° 相等），反映视准轴误差，超限需: The difference between a target's face-left and face-right readings (when reduced to the same side they should be equal ±180°), reflecting collimation-axis error; out of limit requires calibration.
map.依仪器等级，DJ2 一般 2C 互差 ≤13″、半测回差 ≤9″，具体看规范。: By instrument class: DJ2 typically 2C spread ≤13″ and half-set difference ≤9″; see the specification for details.
map.支持方向观测法与复测法两种测量方式，计算角度均值、标准差、标准误差与平差角，并检: Supports both the direction method and the repetition method, computing the angle mean, standard deviation, standard error and adjusted angle, and checking the face-left/face-right 2C spread and observation discrepancies.
map.支持测量格式/度分秒/十进制度三种输入: Supports three input formats: surveying format / DMS / decimal degrees
map.复测法均值精度与残差分析: Repetition-method mean precision and residual analysis
